# 👋 Welcome to TokenOptim Community

Hey! Thanks for finding TokenOptim. This is where we build together.

## 🚀 What is TokenOptim?

Free Chrome extension that:
- Shows token counts + costs on Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok, Kimi, GLM
- Compresses prompts (15-30% savings)
- Caches similar responses (60-90% savings via semantic matching)
- Compares costs across platforms
- All data stays local (zero tracking)

Install in 30 seconds: https://github.com/adifydigitalnoida-del/tokenoptim
